استسمحوا (form X)
# اِسْتَسْمَحُوا (istasmaḥū) /is.tas.ma.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَسْمَحَ (istasmaḥa)
# اُسْتُسْمِحُوا (ustusmiḥū) /us.tus.mi.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَسْمَحَ (istasmaḥa)
# اِسْتَسْمِحُوا (istasmiḥū) /is.tas.mi.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَسْمَحَ (istasmaḥa)
